name: idea-validation-workflow
description: Securely initialize an IdeaTrace client, then capture, clarify, promote, execute, and review Ideas through its API.

interface.shortDescription: Turn natural-language Ideas into verified API workflows.
interface.longDescription: Create a non-secret, release-bound client connection profile from a secure bearer reference, then guide proposers and executors through Idea capture, bounded clarification, explicit promotion, execution facts, structured reports, idempotent recovery, role-oriented reads, and human-governed handoff without creating a second source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Use $idea-validation-init to configure this client without exposing credentials.
Use $idea-validation-workflow to capture this Idea without promoting it.
Use $idea-validation-workflow to read this project and summarize the next allowed step.
